transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess... the main reason I came in is just that I get pulled off track really easily. Like... one Slack ping, or a song lyric, or... I don't know, just a random idea for another project. And suddenly I've just... completely lost the thread of the dashboard I was supposed to be finishing. So... yeah. That's mostly it.
How long have you been experiencing difficulties with staying focused?

Um... I guess for about a year and five months? Give or take. It really started causing problems when I... um, when I moved away from structured school projects. I've been trying to build up a freelance UX and data-visualization portfolio, and... yeah. Since then, mostly.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I don't really notice it myself, but... when I have to sit through meetings or, like, portfolio reviews... I'm usually bouncing my leg or... messing with my rings. Clicking a pen. I just kind of... shift around a lot. Usually I only realize I'm doing it when someone stares at me. So... yeah.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking or blurting out answers before they've finished asking the question?

Um... sometimes, I guess. Like, if people are brainstorming... I might just blurt out an idea. Or... I'll just start adding things to their Figma board before they're even done explaining what they want. I don't really mean to, I just get excited about the design, but... I can tell afterward that I probably came off as pushy. So... yeah. Sometimes.
Do you often have trouble completing tasks or projects that you've started?

Um... yeah, I suppose. Like... if I get a list of revisions for a project... I'll usually do the first one or two right away. But then... I don't know, I just kind of drift off into redesigning some other part of it. And then I end up leaving, like... one small but important change completely unfinished. So... yeah.
Do you often act impulsively in your free time or personal relationships?
Um... not really, no. I mean... I don't think so. I just kind of... hang out with my friends or whatever. Nothing really crazy or impulsive, I guess. So... no, not really.
Can you think of any times when you've said something and later regretted it?
Um... I don't know. I guess everyone says things they wish they hadn't sometimes. But... nothing specific comes to mind. I usually just... keep to myself mostly.
Are your difficulties with focus and restlessness causing problems for you in your relationships or daily life?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean... I've lost a few small freelance things because of it. And... I missed this portfolio competition once because I just... couldn't get it together to finish it on time. People just... kind of feel like they can't rely on me to actually follow through, I guess. And... some of my friends or people I collaborate with... they like my ideas, but they're kind of hesitant to actually work with me now. So... yeah, it causes some issues.
Do you often talk excessively or have trouble waiting your turn in conversations?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I talk too much. I usually just... listen, mostly. I don't really interrupt people. So... no.
How much distress or impairment do you feel your difficulties with focus and restlessness are causing in your daily life or relationships?

Um... well, like I just said... it's mostly just... work stuff. I mean, I've lost those freelance things... and missed that competition. It's just... people don't think I'll follow through. And... yeah, my friends and the people I collaborate with... they like my ideas, but they don't really want to work with me anymore. So... I guess it's somewhat of a problem. But... it's not the end of the world or anything.
Have you experienced any other symptoms or issues that you haven't mentioned yet?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I think that's pretty much everything. I can't really think of anything else right now.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't have these difficulties with focus and restlessness?

Um... well, it hasn't always been this bad, I guess. It really started becoming an issue... maybe a year and a half ago? Like, seventeen months or so. 

Before that, school projects were pretty structured, so it was easier to manage. But since I started trying to build my own portfolio for freelance UX and data-vis stuff... it's just been a lot harder to stay on track. So... yeah, about a year and five months of it being a real problem.
Do you often feel impatient when waiting for others or for things to happen?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... if I have to wait in line for office hours or, you know, checking in at a hackathon... I get pretty antsy. I just sort of... keep checking my watch and shifting around. Sometimes I kind of... want to just jump in before they actually call me. So... yeah, waiting isn't really my favorite thing.
Do you experience these difficulties with focus and restlessness in all areas of your life, or are they mainly a problem in your work or freelance activities?

Um... I guess it's kind of... everywhere. I mean, it definitely affects the freelance stuff. I've actually lost a couple of small contracts recently... and I missed out on a portfolio competition because I just didn't... follow through very cleanly. 

But, um... it's also other things. Like... some of my friends, and people I collaborate with... they're kind of hesitant to work with me now. They say they like my ideas, but... yeah. I guess they just feel like they can't rely on me. So... it's not just the work stuff.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or considered to have any other mental health conditions?
Um... no. Not that I know of. I haven't really... talked to anyone else about this kind of stuff before. So, no.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty sustaining focus during tasks, in childhood, before the age of 12?

Um... yeah. I guess it's been like this for a while. Even back in elementary school... my teachers would write comments on my stuff. Just saying I rushed through worksheets, or... lost track of directions. And that I talked over the other kids during group work. 

My parents... they actually used to have to sit right next to me when I did my homework. Because if they didn't, I'd just... wander off or start doing something else before I finished it. So... yeah.
Did you often get into physical fights or have physical confrontations with others when you were a child?
Um... no. Not really. I wasn't... I didn't get into fights. I was just... easily distracted, I guess. But no, not physical fights.
Did you often have difficulty engaging in activities quietly as a child?

I guess so. Um... even now, if I try to just... relax, like read a book or do a quick sketch, I can't really just sit quietly. I end up talking to myself, or I have to put music on, or I'll stop to check my phone... or I just turn a simple drawing into this huge project. I don't know. I'm just not very good at being quiet with things.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus and restlessness in social situations or when you're alone?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really paid attention to whether it happens more with people or... just by myself. I just don't really know.
